paras: Dugand's blind snake (Trilepida dugandi) is a species of snake in the family Leptotyphlopidae. The species is endemic to South America.
The specific name, dugandi, is in honor of Colombian naturalist Armando Dugand.
T. dugandi is found in Atlántico Department, Colombia.
The preferred natural habitats of T. dugandi are forest and shrubland, at altitudes from sea level to 800 m (2,600 ft), but it has also been found in rural gardens.
Dorsally, T. dugandi is brown with seven dark copper stripes. Ventrally, it is cream-colored.
